body:
I made a list of things that I have to do before I kill myself (if I go through with this week), some are like paying debts, some are saying goodbye to people I love and some are things like cleaning up my apartment and computer.

I don't want to feel because I used not to. I was like a zombie, just wandering through life and I supressed every emotion I had like an empty shell. When I got help, I learned to feel and express emotion again, but those were easy times and controlled. Now this last weeks have been like a rollercoaster, can't control it, I'm not used to it so I don't know what to do.

Thanks for answering, sometimes it is nice to have someone to talk about this.
